snippet.title: World Simulation 1.0 – The Whole Planet, Playable - for iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro
snippet.description:
World Simulation 1.0: the whole planet, playable. 🌍

Drive any street on Earth, fly from 3,244 real airports, race through real cities, drive a taxi, chase or get chased, and launch to the Moon and Mars. Play online with friends on iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro.

🆓 Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/world-simulation-drive-fly/id6816245733
🌐 worldsimulation.devpool.fr

All footage is captured in-game.

#WorldSimulation #OpenWorld #IndieGame #AppleVisionPro #FlightSimulator #iOSGames
